OWNER DECISION 2026-10-14 (binding): the release gate requires migration 016 (the governed derived-generation purge, docs/development/v3-governed-derived-purge-design.md) exactly as design 8.1 says: the required applied set is [014, 010, 011-rewritten, 013, 015, 016] with exact ledger hashes. 016 does NOT exist yet (a later governed-purge code PR registers it, as the release doc already states). Tests prove that refusal and prove the gate would pass for a fixture manifest/ledger that does contain all six with matching hashes. Do not create 016 or any purge code.

1. ATTESTATION SCHEMA. Extend accepted_release_schema_compatibility validation in scripts/operator/v3_production_deploy.py with the F2d fields: ranking_version (non-empty bounded string), ranking_sha256 (64 lowercase hex), f2d_operator_code_sha256 (64 lowercase hex), and the rollback boundary of 8.1 (minimum_schema_compatible_image: a digest-pinned backend image reference in the same form as images.backend; and the trimmed rollback target list, named as the design and existing code suggest). They are OPTIONAL as a group for the current accepted release (bed755b9 has none and must still validate unchanged -- do not edit its values in target-authority.json), but when any one is present all must be present and well-formed; a partial group refuses. Validation errors are explicit and listed.

2. F2D RELEASE GATE (8.1). In the promote path, when the candidate release is an F2d release (decide the detection from the code and design -- e.g. the candidate's applied-set/compatibility or a candidate manifest field; name the rule you chose), require before promotion, each with its own named refusal: the exact current PUBLISHED generation key ratings_v4_prod_p4_parallel_v1 / UUID cfc25d36-3bc7-4011-a465-d6460eaaf826 / sequence 1; the required applied migration set above with exact ledger hashes (016 refusal as described); the candidate attestation carries concrete ranking_version/ranking_sha256 and f2d_operator_code_sha256; NO Finder product rows (system_search or system_archetype) on the parallel_v1 generation -- NOT an empty v3_meta.derived_product, because opt1's READY system_search product row is retained for ever; and a compatible rollback artifact at or after the minimum schema-compatible image is recorded (refuse otherwise). It must NOT require product READY, receipts, row counts, published_at or audit rows. After promotion, run the behavioural probe pairs of 8.1 against the active loopback origin (GET /api/archetypes/rankings ... offset=9999&limit=1 -> 503 and limit=2 -> 422; POST /api/local/search from=9999,size=1 -> 503 and size=2 -> 422; reuse part D2a's exact URLs/bodies from scripts/operator/actions/v3-publish-derived-products.sh) and record every status in the promotion receipt; a mismatch fails the promotion through the existing rollback path. Reads only, parameterized SQL, bounded statements.

3. ROLLBACK BOUNDARY (8.1). Images earlier than the minimum schema-compatible image are marked incompatible with the applied set; the rollback target list is cut to images at or after it; tests assert the trimmed list and the refusal.

4. ATTESTED IDENTITY WIRING (8.3). Remove the temporary workflow_dispatch input f2d_operator_code_sha256_attested from .github/workflows/chatgpt-ed-new-ops.yml. Non-F2d operations are unchanged. Update every test that asserts the old input.
